name: hand-activation-class-bonus-discount-affordable-at-discounted-cost
notes: Lead with Force (yhu0djqlp8, printed reserve 3, [Class Bonus] costs 1 less) with the champion patched to a MAGE/TAMER Nameless Champion: the Class Bonus is active, so the activation costs 2 and the two other hand cards are enough. The affordability gate must use the actual calculated cost (CalculateActivationReserveCost), not the printed cost, or this hand would be refused. Pins that a discounted activation is not over-refused.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] This card costs (1) less to activate.
Reserve cost is paid by sending cards from your hand to memory.
